title: Surreal Clock Lake Dream
description: A surreal collage-style scene shows a small black silhouette figure holding a bright red umbrella while standing on giant clock faces floating on water. In the background, a large fragmented female face with gold leaf details peers over a layered dreamlike landscape containing a lone tree on an island, floating lanterns, glowing bubbles, and colorful geometric shapes, all framed by a torn burlap border.
prompt: Surreal dreamlike collage scene featuring a small black figure with a bright red umbrella standing on giant cracked clock faces floating on dark green water. A massive fragmented woman's face with gold leaf patches and green foliage in her hair looks down from the top right. Behind her are cloudy skies with glowing lanterns, a lone tree on a small island, purple smoke, and colorful floating geometric shapes. The entire composition has a torn, frayed burlap frame border, cinematic lighting with a glowing green portal in the distance, whimsical and mysterious atmosphere.
